name: Waqt Waw
summary: A bold Arabic و, the opening letter of وقت, with a warm flowing tail.
why: The enclosed head and broad leftward tail retain the structure of an isolated Arabic waw. Its rounded curves feel relaxed, while the warm tail gives the letter a memorable gesture. The connection to وقت makes time part of the identity without drawing a clock.
risk: The letter is clearest to Arabic readers. Without that context it can resemble a numeral 9, and the app name supplies the prayer meaning.
reasonToChoose: You want a distinctly Arabic, personal identity.
